about.bio: I am a software engineer who builds across the whole stack, from Spring Boot and Angular products to Python data and machine learning services. My six month end of studies project, a complete AI driven fintech platform, builds on five internships in web, mobile and data. I enjoy turning real needs into reliable solutions and keep exploring data, AI and DevOps.

exp1.role: Software Engineer, End of Studies Project
exp1.summary: IZI Supervision: an intelligent supervision and analytics platform for Zitouna Bank's IZI Wallet, delivered across six sprints.

items.title: Monitoring
items.need: Clients and administrators lacked visibility on wallet activity.
items.solution: A secure web platform with real time dashboards for both profiles.

items.title: Data
items.need: Raw production data was not ready for analytics.
items.solution: An automated ETL pipeline feeding a validated data warehouse, with built in quality controls.

items.title: Fraud detection
items.need: Suspicious behaviour had to be spotted and justified.
items.solution: A hybrid engine combining client segmentation, risk scoring and anomaly detection into one explainable risk level.

items.title: AI assistant
items.need: Users needed instant help in their own language.
items.solution: A multilingual chatbot powered by LLMs, grounded in bank knowledge through RAG, and able to detect user intent to trigger actions directly.

items.title: Financial insights
items.need: Users struggled to anticipate their finances.
items.solution: A recommendation engine for bill prediction, spending forecasts, budget optimization and financial health scoring, refreshed by a nightly pipeline.

items.title: Mobile
items.need: The platform had to reach users on their phones.
items.solution: A Flutter app reusing the same backend, with no duplicated business logic.

exp2.description: Farm operators needed to anticipate livestock health issues. The proposed solution was a mobile app to monitor and control the farm, flagging risks from key environmental factors.

exp3.description: A laboratory needed to replace manual tracking. The proposed solution was an application automating equipment, stock, user and test workflows.

exp4.description: The company needed one central place for its payment methods. The proposed solution was a web application that digitizes and centralizes them.

exp5.description: The airline needed digital handling of flight tickets. The proposed solution was a web application for flight ticket management.

project1.title: IZI Supervision
project1.description: Wallet clients and administrators lacked visibility and early warning. The proposed solution is an AI driven supervision platform combining real time dashboards, fraud detection, a multilingual LLM assistant with RAG and intent detection, and financial insights.

project2.title: Incident Reporting Platform
project2.description: Public issues were slow to reach the authorities. The proposed solution lets citizens photograph an incident and report it, so government services can receive, process and resolve it.

project3.title: Real Time Traffic Simulation
project3.description: Urban congestion needed smarter control. The proposed solution is a reinforcement learning agent that optimizes simulated city traffic, with an interactive dashboard.

project4.title: Engineering Cycle Management
project4.description: Schools needed to follow engineering students from admission to graduation. The proposed solution is a web platform managing the full academic journey in one place.

project5.title: Smart Farm Mobile App
project5.description: Farmers needed to supervise their farm and equipment remotely. The proposed solution is a mobile app connected to an IoT system for live environmental data and remote control of cameras and water pumps.

project6.title: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction
project6.description: Investors needed to anticipate market trends from scattered sources. The proposed solution is an automated data collection pipeline feeding a predictive trend model.
